{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "ULTRA PROMPT – Create a premium static event marketing website for an Accounting & Finance Conference 2026.

Build a modern LIGHT MODE landing page for a fictional event called “Ledger Forward Summit 2026” – an accounting, tax, bookkeeping, payroll, audit, and finance operations conference for small business owners, accountants, CFOs, and finance teams.

IMPORTANT: This is a pure static front-end website only. No backend, no login, no payment, no database, no real registration system, no real API. Use mock/static/sample content only. All buttons can scroll to sections or open static modal/anchor. The site must be fully renderable as a static website.

TECH REQUIREMENT:
- Use React for the static front-end
- Use GSAP animations for smooth premium interactions
- No Three.js, no WebGL, no canvas games, no physics
- Responsive design for desktop, tablet, mobile
- Clean component structure
- Light theme only
- Design inspiration: Medium.com style editorial layout — lots of whitespace, elegant typography, readable sections, soft dividers, content-first, polished but not too corporate

BRANDING:
Event name: Ledger Forward Summit 2026
Tagline: “Where modern accounting meets smarter business decisions.”
Location: Austin, Texas
Date: September 14–16, 2026
Audience: accountants, bookkeepers, finance managers, startup founders, tax consultants, payroll teams, CFOs
Tone: trustworthy, modern, intelligent, calm, premium, educational

COLOR PALETTE:
- Background: #FAF8F3 or warm off-white
- Main text: #1F2933
- Accent green: #1F7A5A
- Soft mint: #DFF3EA
- Warm gold accent: #C99A3D
- Light gray borders: #E7E2D8
- White cards with very soft shadows

TYPOGRAPHY:
- Editorial serif for big headings if possible
- Clean sans-serif for body text
- Huge readable hero title
- Medium-style article cards
- Avoid generic startup SaaS look; make it feel like a respected finance publication + conference website

PAGE STRUCTURE REQUIRED:

1. STICKY NAVBAR
- Left: event logo text “Ledger Forward”
- Links: Overview, Agenda, Speakers, Workshops, Pricing, FAQ
- CTA button: “Reserve Seat”
- On mobile show clean hamburger menu
- Navbar should shrink or add subtle shadow on scroll using GSAP or CSS

2. HERO SECTION
- Large editorial headline:
  “The accounting event for firms ready to work smarter.”
- Supporting paragraph:
  “Three days of practical sessions, tax planning insights, workflow automation, advisory strategy, and finance leadership conversations.”
- CTA buttons:
  Primary: “View Agenda”
  Secondary: “Meet Speakers”
- Add event meta pills: Austin TX / Sep 14–16 2026 / 38 Sessions / 900 Attendees
- Right side hero card styled like a printed conference pass or agenda preview:
  “Day 1 Keynote: Closing the books in half the time”
  Speaker: Maya Ellison, CPA
  Time: 9:30 AM
- GSAP hero animation: headline fade up, pills stagger, pass card float in

3. TRUST / STATS STRIP
Add clean statistics section:
- 900+ finance professionals
- 42 expert speakers
- 18 CPE-style learning sessions (mock only, no accreditation claims)
- 3 days of workshops
Use simple icons or text only. No external icon API required.

4. OVERVIEW SECTION
Title: “Built for the new era of accounting work”
Three feature columns:
- Advisory-first client service
- Smarter month-end workflows
- Better tax planning conversations
Each with short paragraph, light card design.

5. FEATURED TOPICS SECTION
Make it look like Medium article cards, not boring boxes.
Cards with category labels:
- Tax Strategy: “Planning before the deadline panic”
- Practice Growth: “From compliance work to advisory revenue”
- Automation: “Reducing repetitive bookkeeping tasks”
- Payroll: “Cleaner systems for growing teams”
- Audit: “Risk review without spreadsheet chaos”
- Leadership: “Finance teams that explain the story behind numbers”
Cards should animate in with GSAP scroll reveal.

6. AGENDA SECTION
Create a detailed static agenda with tabs or day selector for Day 1, Day 2, Day 3. Tabs can be simple client-side UI only.
Day 1 theme: Foundations & Strategy
- 9:30 Keynote: Closing the Books Faster
- 11:00 Panel: The Future of Client Advisory
- 1:30 Workshop: Month-End Workflow Mapping
- 3:00 Session: Better Cash Flow Reporting
Day 2 theme: Tax, Payroll & Compliance
- 9:00 Keynote: Calm Tax Season Systems
- 10:45 Session: Payroll Controls for Scaling Companies
- 1:00 Workshop: Client Document Checklists
- 2:45 Roundtable: Compliance Without Burnout
Day 3 theme: Growth & Leadership
- 9:30 Session: Pricing Accounting Services with Confidence
- 11:00 Workshop: Building a Finance Dashboard Story
- 1:30 Panel: What CFOs Need From Accounting Teams
- 3:30 Closing Notes: The Next Five Years of the Profession
Each agenda item needs time, title, type, short description, and speaker name.

7. SPEAKERS SECTION
Create 8 fictional speakers with professional static content:
- Maya Ellison, CPA – Founder, ClearLedger Advisory
- Omar Bennett – Finance Operations Lead, Northstar Retail Group
- Clara Voss – Tax Strategy Consultant
- Jonathan Reed – Fractional CFO
- Priya Shah – Payroll Systems Specialist
- Elena Morris – Audit & Controls Advisor
- Marcus Lee – Practice Growth Coach
- Hannah Brooks – Bookkeeping Workflow Educator
Use elegant profile cards. Since no image tool needed, use initials avatars or soft gradient placeholders, not real photos.

8. WORKSHOPS SECTION
Show 4 workshop cards:
- Month-End Close Blueprint
- Client Advisory Conversation Lab
- Tax Season Readiness Sprint
- Finance Dashboard Storytelling
Each card: duration, level, who should attend, what you’ll leave with.

9. VENUE / EXPERIENCE SECTION
Static content about venue:
- Austin River Hall, fictional venue
- Light editorial layout with large quote:
  “A calm, focused space for the people who keep businesses financially grounded.”
- Include bullets: quiet networking lounges, breakfast roundtables, workbook materials, sponsor-free learning blocks
No map integration, no real location widget.

10. PRICING SECTION
Static pricing cards only, no checkout.
Three tiers:
- Early Bird Pass – $349 – best for solo accountants
- Team Pass – $899 – best for firms sending 3 people
- Workshop Plus – $549 – includes one deep-dive workshop
Each has features and CTA “Choose Pass” that scrolls to static contact/reserve section or opens a simple fake confirmation message.
Add note: “Static demo pricing for layout purposes.”

11. TESTIMONIALS SECTION
Use mock testimonials from fictional attendees:
- “The most practical finance event I’ve attended.”
- “It felt calm, smart, and actually useful.”
- “The workflow sessions gave our firm a real plan.”
Include names and roles.

12. FAQ SECTION
Accordion UI, static front-end only:
Questions:
- Is this a real registration form?
Answer: This demo uses static sample content only.
- Who is the event for?
- Are sessions recorded?
- Is there a virtual option?
- Can teams attend together?
- What should I bring?

13. RESERVE / CONTACT SECTION
Create a beautiful static lead section at bottom:
Heading: “Save your seat for the next chapter of accounting.”
Fields visually displayed only: Name, Email, Company, Pass Type
Important: form does not submit anywhere. On click show a front-end only success state like “Thanks! This static demo has no backend.”
CTA: “Reserve Seat”

14. FOOTER
- Logo text
- Event date/location
- Links repeated
- Small disclaimer: “Fictional static event website. No real registration or payment processing.”

GSAP ANIMATION REQUIREMENTS:
- Hero entrance animation
- Scroll-triggered reveal for section headings and cards
- Agenda item stagger animation when switching day tabs
- Subtle hover animations on cards and CTA buttons
- Smooth scroll for nav links
- Keep animations tasteful, not too flashy

DESIGN DETAILS:
- Must feel like a polished conference site for professionals, not a crypto/web3 landing page
- Light background, clean editorial spacing
- Cards should have thin borders, gentle radius, subtle shadow
- Use section labels like “Agenda”, “Workshops”, “Speakers”
- Add some horizontal rules/dividers like Medium publication pages
- Use large quote blocks and article-like cards
- Make it visually balanced, premium, and readable

DELIVERABLE:
Create the full static React website with all sections above. Use mock data arrays for speakers, agenda, pricing, FAQ, topics etc. Make sure the website works without external services and looks complete on mobile and desktop.",

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
# webdev-structural-gate@1: necessary conditions, not a replacement judge.
_gate_layout = {}
for _line in (shot["output"] or "").splitlines():
    if _line.startswith("LAYOUT:"):
        try:
            _gate_layout = json.loads(_line[len("LAYOUT:"):])
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            pass
        break
if (not isinstance(_gate_layout, dict) or _gate_layout.get("error")
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("text"), str)
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("scroll_w"), (int, float))
        or not isinstance(_gate_layout.get("client_w"), (int, float))
        or _gate_layout["client_w"] <= 0):
    done(None, "Structural measurements unavailable; not scored.")
_gate_text = " ".join(_gate_layout["text"].split())
_gate_kw = cfg.get("gate_keywords") or []
_gate_fails = []
if not _gate_text:
    _gate_fails.append("blank rendered DOM")
if _gate_kw and not any(_kw.casefold() in _gate_text.casefold() for _kw in _gate_kw):
    _gate_fails.append("no brief-keyword DOM presence")
if _gate_layout["scroll_w"] > _gate_layout["client_w"] + 1:
    _gate_fails.append("horizontal overflow")
_gate_report = {"passed": not _gate_fails, "failed": _gate_fails,
                "dom_chars": len(_gate_text), "keywords": _gate_kw,
                "layout": _gate_layout}
(V / "structural_gates.json").write_text(json.dumps(_gate_report, indent=1))
if _gate_fails:
    done(0.0, "Structural gates failed: " + "; ".join(_gate_fails),
         structural_gates=_gate_fails)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Gate trivial, off-brief and overflowing pages to a scored 0 before the vision call, cutting judge spend and the blank-page lottery. Passing pages reach the judge unchanged.

The accounting event for firms ready to work smarter.
